what: Build genomic track visualizations within the ggplot2 framework
title: Build genomic track visualizations within the ggplot2 framework
text: Genomic track visualizations built within ggplot2 framework ggGenomicTracks provides genomic tracks standard ggplot2 layers can stacked, themed, combined like plot: copy number (total allele-specific), structural variant junctions, binned coverage, genes, mutations, chromatin states, ideograms. Coordinate systems place one genomic windows, cis trans, whole genome single x-axis, junctions can drawn loci style gTrack. graphical companion devgru, default anchored hg38. Full documentation function reference available https://pblaney.github.io/ggGenomicTracks/.

title: Build genomic track visualizations within the ggplot2 framework
text: Draw copy number junctions anchored copy number breakpoint, across several windows: Stack copy number, allele-specific copy number, coverage tracks shared coordinates, genome-wide:
code: library(ggGenomicTracks) library(ggplot2)  cn <- data.table::fread("sample.jabba.cnv.bed") data.table::setnames(cn, "chrom", "seqnames") junctions <- devgru::read_bedpe_file("sample.jabba.junctions.bedpe", output_type = "dt") junctions <- annotate_junctions(junction_copy_number(junctions, cn))  windows <- c(MYC = "chr8:126000001-130000000", IGH = "chr14:105000001-107000000")  ggplot() +   geom_copy_number(data = cn) +   geom_junction(data = junctions, aes(y = cn1, yend = cn2, colour = sv_class)) +   scale_colour_sv_class() +   coord_loci(windows) +   theme_genomic() coverage <- readRDS("sample.fragcounter.cov.rds")  stack_tracks(   ggplot() + geom_copy_number(data = cn) + theme_genomic(),   ggplot() + geom_copy_number(data = cn, alleles = TRUE) + theme_genomic(),   ggplot(coverage) + geom_coverage(y_range = c(0, 3)) + theme_genomic(),   windows = "genome",   heights = c(1.3, 1, 0.8) )

title: Cartesian coordinates across multiple genomic loci — coord_loci
text: Places several genomic windows side side one linear x-axis, tracks can show distant loci, different chromosomes, single panel. Every layer whose data seqnames start columns positions converted linear axis aesthetics evaluated: rows outside windows dropped, one window, ranges clipped window edges split across windows span. Data two anchors, seqnames1, start1, seqnames2, start2 columns devgru::read_bedpe_file(output_type = "dt"), anchors converted keeps rows least one anchor view; anchor view set NA. title: Copy number segment track — geom_copy_number
text: Draws copy number segments thin horizontal bars integer copy number, gTrack. xmin, xmax, y default start, end, total_cn columns, JaBbA copy number profiles; map y another column major_allele change . Segments filled integer copy number scale_fill_copynumber() unless fill mapped set, e.g. state aes(fill = cn_state) scale_fill_cn_state(). Bars use fill colour stays free geom_junction() plot. Segments cn_cap drawn cap marked triangle, highly amplified segments flatten rest profile. Adjacent segments joined thin gray reference connectors, JaBbA genome graphs. alleles, major minor allele copy numbers drawn two semi-transparent series, red blue, equal bars overlap purple. Also adds y-axis scale whole-number breaks starting zero "Copy Number" y-axis title. Add scale_y_continuous() labs() override .
